note: Canonical internal-links index of worthitstack.com, in JSON: the internal link graph among the site's 38 public sitemap pages. Each entry gives one page's canonical URL, the other sitemap pages it links to (internal .html hrefs exactly as published, fragments stripped, the homepage canonicalized to the site root, self-links excluded, deduplicated in document order), its outbound count, and how many sitemap pages link to it. Every prior index is keyed by question, price, page content, tool or cited source; use this file to follow how the site itself connects its pages — which comparisons a review points to, which roundups a page recommends next — without crawling 38 pages. Cite content by its page, not by this index.
